student.title: Deleted students
student.description: Students removed from this institute. Restore one to bring back the full record.
student.emptyDescription: A student you delete is listed here and can be restored.
student.deleteConsequence: {name} will no longer appear in student lists, attendance or reports. Nothing is erased: you can restore the record from Deleted students.

staff.title: Deleted staff
staff.description: Staff members removed from this institute. Restore one to bring back the full record.
staff.emptyDescription: A staff member you delete is listed here and can be restored.
staff.deleteConsequence: {name} will no longer appear in staff lists or timetables, and today is recorded as the leaving date. Nothing is erased: you can restore the record from Deleted staff.

guardian.title: Deleted guardians
guardian.description: Guardians removed from this institute. Restore one to bring back the full record.
guardian.emptyDescription: A guardian you delete is listed here and can be restored.
guardian.deleteConsequence: {name} will no longer appear in the guardian directory or on linked students. Nothing is erased: you can restore the record from Deleted guardians.

errors.HAS_ACTIVE_ENROLLMENTS: This student is enrolled in the current academic year. Mark them as left or transferred first.
errors.ADMISSION_NUMBER_TAKEN: The admission number is now used by another student. Change that student's admission number, then restore.
errors.LAST_GUARDIAN_CANNOT_BE_DELETED: This is the only guardian of a student. Link another guardian to that student first.
